comment: Index affricate → ASCA delayed-release (no feature named affricate). Needs comprehensive validation.
Index back vowel; V:[+back] tighter than bare [+back] (also matches velars/uvulars). Needs comprehensive validation.
Index front vowel; V:[+front] tighter than bare [+front] (also matches palatals). Needs comprehensive validation.
Index laryngeal ≈ glottals (h, ɦ, ʔ); replaces invalid/overbroad [+laryngeal]. Needs comprehensive validation.
Index approximant; ASCA approximant also includes vowels/liquids. Needs comprehensive validation.
Index velar approx (same matrix as SoundChangeRule.aliases). Needs comprehensive validation.
Index palatovelar approx — not exact. Needs comprehensive validation.
Index diphthong approx; ASCA has no diphthong class. Needs comprehensive validation.
Index labial/bilabial; C:[+labial] avoids bare [+labial] on rounded vowels. Needs comprehensive validation.
Index also means uvular; this covers clicks only. Needs comprehensive validation.
Index resonant/sonorant ≈ ASCA S (nasals+liquids only). Needs comprehensive validation.
Index plosive ↔ ASCA plosive grouping P
ASCA whole syllable (not a segment; cannot substitute %↔segment). Needs comprehensive validation.
Index semivowel ≈ ASCA glides G. Needs comprehensive validation.
Index continuant; ASCA also includes vowels/trills. Needs comprehensive validation.
